book.name: MADIU
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Pekpen Manaman ehu
Parisi oh Sadusi kei ahpw patohdo rehn Sises pwe re en lidipihedi, iei me re patohwan pekihki en ketin wiahiong irail ehu manamanen, pwe en kasalehda en Koht eh ketin kadehde duwen ih.
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ni eh kin soutikpene, kumwail kin nda, ‘Lakapw e pahn kaselel, pwe pahnlahng me poh weitahta.’

A nimenseng kumwail kin nda, ‘Rahnwet e pahn keteu, pwe pahnlahng me poh weitahta oh mahliok.’ Eri, kumwail kak kasawihada iren ahnsou sang ni mwomwen pahnlahng; ahpw kumwail sohte kak kasawihada kilel kan duwen ahnsou pwukat!

Ia uwen suwed oh soaloalopwoat en aramas en ahnsou wet kan!” E ahpw pil ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail pekipeki rehi ehu manamanen? Soh! Ihte manaman me pahn kohieing kumwailen, manaman en Sona.” Ih eri ketiketla sang irail, ketiketlahng ekis wasa.
Ihsen Parisi oh Sadusi kan
Ni tohnpadahk ko ar kotehla leho oh lel palio, re ahpw diarada me re manokehla sehrehda konotarail pilawa.
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail mwasahn, oh kalikasang kumwail ihsen Parisi oh Sadusi kan.”
Irail eri tapihada ndindapene nanpwungarail, “E mahsanih met pwehki atail sohte wisik pilawa kohdo.”
Sises mwahngihada dahme re ndindapene nanpwungarail, ihme e ketin keinemwehki rehrail, mahsanih, “Dahme kumwail ndindahki duwen eh sohte pilawa rehmwail? Kumwail meid pwoson tikitik!
Kumwail saikinte marainla? Kumwail sohte tamataman lopwon en pilawa limawo me I piltikihpeseng rehn aramas limekido? Kopwou depe me kumwail deukada?
A lopwon en pilawa isuhwo rehn aramas pahkido? Kopwou depe me kumwail deukadao?
Dahme kumwail sohte dehdehkihki me kaidehn pilawa me I ndindahki? Kumwail kalikasang kumwail ihsen Parisi oh Sadusi kan.”
Tohnpadahk ko eri dehdehkihda me kaidehkin ihsen nan pilawa me re en kalikasang irail, pwe padahk en Parisi oh Sadusi ko.
En Piter eh Kadehde duwen Sises
Sises eri ketiketlahng wasa kis limwahn kahnimw en Sesaria Pilipai, wasao e ahpw keinemwe rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, mahsanih, “Dahme aramas akan kin ndinda duwen Nein-Aramas, ihs ih?”
Irail eri sapeng, patohwanohng, “Ekei kin patohwan me komwi iei Sohn Sounpapidais; a ekei dene Elaisa, a ekei me Seremaia de emen soukohp ako.”
A Sises keinemwe rehrail, “A kumwail, ihs me kumwail wiahkin ie?”
Saimon Piter ahpw sapeng, patohwanohng, “Komwi me Mesaiao, Sapwellimen Koht ieias.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Meid pai kowe, Saimon, nein Sohn, pwe kaidehkin aramas me kasalehiong uhk mehlel pwoatet, pwe Semei me ketiket nanleng.
Eri, met I ndaiong uhk, pwe kowe Piter, paipalap ehu, oh pohn paipalap wet I pahn kauwada ei mwomwohdiso. Oh mehla sohte pahn kak kalowehdi.
I pahn kihong uhk kih kan en Wehin Koht: mehkoaros me ke pahn keinapwihdi nin sampah pil pahn keinapwihdi nanleng; oh mehkoaros me ke pahn mweidada nin sampah, e pahn mweimweida nanleng.”
Sises eri mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, re dehpa ndaiong emen, me iei ih Mesaiao.
Sises ketin Kohpada duwen eh pahn Lokolok oh Pwoula

Sang ni ahnsowo kohla, Sises ketin tapihada mahsen sansal ong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “I uhdahn pahn kohdalahng Serusalem oh ale lokolok laud sang rehn soumas oh samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kan. I pahn kamakamala, a I ahpw pahn iasada ni kesiluhwen rahn.”
Piter ahpw kelehpwkihla Sises oh tapihada kapwungohng, patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, Koht ketin keinapwih soahng wet, mepwukat sohte mwahn pahn lelohng komwi!”
Sises ahpw ketin pirekeksang Piter oh mahsanih, “Kohla mwuri, kowe Sehdan! Meninkau men kowe rehi, pwe ke kin lemelemehte mehkan me en aramas, a kaidehkin mehkan me sapwellimen Koht.”
Sises eri mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Mehmen me men idawehniehdo, en tounmeteikihla pein ih, kapaikada eh lohpwu, oh idawehniehdo.
Pwe aramas emen me men doarehla eh mour, e pahn pwupwusang; a mehmen me men tounmeteikihla eh mour, pwehki ngehi, e pahn diar.
Pwe da katepehiong aramas emen, ma e alehdi kepwe koaros en sampah pokon, e ahpw pahn pwupwusang eh mour? Sohte mehkot aramas kak kihda pwe en wiliankihla pwupwulahn eh mour.
Pwe Nein-Aramas pahn ketido nin lingaling en Seme, oh sapwellime tohnleng kan pahn iang; e ahpw pahn katingih emenemen aramas nin duwen eh wiewia kan.
Kumwail en ese pwe ekei me iang mihmi met, re sohte pahn mehla, irail lao pahn kilang Nein-Aramas eh pahn ketido nin duwen Nanmwarki men.”
